title: Refactored Space, time derivatives, the electromagnetic field strength and the tensor API, and sped up the slowest files
summary: Replaced the Space d.succ convention by Space d throughout the library and simplified the curl and distributional Laplacian definitions. Replaced the field strength matrix by index expressions on the field strength tensor and reworked the tensor API it depends on. Rewrote the slowest declarations after profiling the whole library, and replaced a home-grown number type by its Mathlib equivalent. Introduced derivVec, the time derivative of trajectories into torsors, and switched the rigid-body and pendulum velocities to it; made the differentiability API of the electromagnetic potential and fields usable by fun_prop.
